pages.text: The rain had just stopped, and the garden smelled fresh and sweet. Muddy puddles sparkled in the sunlight, and <name> wiggled his toes in his chappals.
But oh no! One chappal had disappeared! “Where did it go?” <name> wondered, peeking under marigolds and behind big clay pots.
Suddenly, a green frog hopped by and said, “Looking for something?” “Yes! My chappal!” giggled <name>.

The frog croaked, “Follow me!” They splashed through little puddles together. Next, a tiny snail slid slowly along the path. “Maybe it’s behind me!” said the snail. <name> laughed, imagining a snail carrying his chappal on its back.
Then a shiny black crow perched on a mango tree and cawed, “Clue! Clue!” <name> ran and looked — there it was, stuck in a leafy bush!
“Hooray!” <name> cheered, slipping the chappal back on. Mud squished between his toes, and laughter bubbled out.
That day, <name> learned that even a tiny search can be a fun adventure, full of friends, imagination, and muddy little surprises! 🌧️🐸🌀
